suno_pipeline: 1. Analyze extracted knowledge for recurring technical themes
2. Select theme based on frequency, recency, and musical potential
3. Generate song concept (title, mood, BPM, narrative arc)
4. Compose lyrics using technical metaphors and cyberpop imagery
5. Build Suno prompt (genre tags, BPM, vocal style, production notes)
6. Validate factual claims against extracted knowledge (DoT)
strudel_pipeline: 1. Analyze extracted knowledge for technical concepts
2. Map concepts to musical structures (e.g., recursion → nested patterns)
4. Generate Tidal Cycles code with appropriate synths and effects
7. Track evidence IDs for concept-pattern mapping
